list.description: The list the bullet belongs to

text.description: The bullet: one sentence of your own words. It never copies a sentence or part of a sentence from the transcript; a short qualifier of the speaker's (about six words at most) may be kept exactly, only where it is inside this bullet's own quote

items.description: A passage of one turn that states the bullet's point, copied exactly from the transcript

quotes.description: A management or unknown bullet: exactly one passage (one sentence, or two that follow each other, from one turn). An analysts bullet: one to three passages (the question and, if it directly follows, management's answer)
